q: 3. In the economic analysis, all the cost and benefit and analyzed keeping in the basket of
explain: Economic analysis counts costs and benefits to the nation as a whole.

q: 4. In economic analysis a shift in the supply curve is said to take place due to
explain: Shifts in supply (rather than movement along the curve) are caused by external factors like tech, costs, or competition.

q: 5. Subsidy provided to private enterprises is taken as ...... for the financial analysis of any project.
explain: In financial analysis a subsidy received is treated as revenue (inflow) to the enterprise.

q: 6. Fundamental decision criteria for acceptability of a public project is ......
explain: Public projects are accepted mainly on economic merit, i.e. benefit to society.

q: 7. The ratio analysis of a construction firm is used for the analysis by:
explain: Ratio analysis is a core component of financial analysis used to interpret financial statements.

q: 8. Donor funded projects are based on ......
explain: Donor-funded projects consider government priority, user priority and a satisfactory IRR.
Appraisal means evaluating a proposed option and selecting the best one.

q: 10. The project risk that will encounter due to earthquake in which both contracting parties are unable to control the situation is ......
explain: Force majeure covers events like earthquakes beyond the control of both contracting parties.

q: 11. If % decrease in demand is less than % increase in the price, then sale ......
explain: Demand is inelastic here, so the price rise outweighs the fall in quantity and sales revenue increases.

q: 12. Inflation due to increase in population ......
explain: More people raise demand, which pulls prices up: demand-pull inflation.

q: 13. Inflation due to increase in electricity prices ......
explain: Higher input cost (electricity) pushes production costs and prices up: cost-push inflation.

q: 14. According to law of demand if the price of good increases then the demand of articles ......
explain: Law of demand: price and quantity demanded move in opposite directions.

q: 15. According to law of supply if the price of goods increases then the supply of goods ......
explain: Law of supply: a higher price encourages suppliers to supply more.
